scope: adversarial design gates in this repository

notes.min_families: Three, because measured here one family iterated six times found only P1s and the first three-family round found six P0s. Diversity is what found them, not depth.
notes.blocking: Only a reproduction that executed -- exit 0 and a VIOLATION line -- can block. An assertion, however confident, is a Question. This is what lets settlement survive co-located roster keys: a repro is re-runnable by a stranger, a signature is not.
notes.novelty: Per normative clause, not per transcript. SPEC.md §7 delegates relevance to the active policy and warns that purely syntactic novelty is unbounded; without this a reviewer perturbs the repro and manufactures findings forever.
notes.custody: Roster keys claude-fable-5 and codex were co-located on one host as of 2026-07-28. Two signatures from one host are ONE custody, and no report produced under this policy may present them as independent attestation.
notes.not_adoption: Settlement authorises a merge under this policy. Governance adoption is a separate threshold warrant signed by roster keys (AGENTS.md §2).
notes.recognized_families: Diversity was counted from distinct values of a command-line flag, so three spellings of one reviewer satisfied the three-family rule. Only rosters listed here count; adding a family is a deliberate act.
notes.gating_families: Only these satisfy min_families. Measured on this repository, 2026-07-29: across four gate runs codex produced seven findings that all survived verification, while the local models produced one useful observation and one forged violation. Counting probes toward a quorum would manufacture the appearance of an independent gate out of noise -- which is the exact failure this whole mechanism exists to prevent, and it would be committed first by the mechanism itself.
notes.probe_families: Run them: they are free, their findings are read, and one of them did surface a real clause-collision. They are stochastic probes, not reviewers, and they do not count toward diversity. A finding from a probe is worth exactly as much as its reproduction, same as any other.
notes.ungated_landing: A rule that cannot be satisfied is not a strict rule, it is a rule people route around, and the first to route around it would be the maintainer. With every gating family unavailable, min_families can never be met, so the honest state is not OPEN-forever but UNGATED: nothing is wrong, and nothing was independently checked. Naming that is the whole value; hiding it behind a threshold nobody can reach would turn the mechanism into decoration, which is worse than not having it.

ungated_landing.requires: an explicit attestation naming who took responsibility and what was run in place of a gate
ungated_landing.reason: no gating family is affordable; the steward assigned merge responsibility to the maintainer actor
